headline.text: L3 ML4 has *5 open cleaning issues* flagged for Monday — L1 ran caramel through the weekend with minor equipment holds.

per_plant_summary.L1: Sollich 2 ran dark caramel through second shift with a metal detector glitch at 15:20 that cleared by 15:24. Sollich 3 ran pecan clusters overnight; butter melter went cold at 21:44 but had enough caramel to finish the shift. Corn syrup pump motor failed on Sollich 2 and was scheduled for third-shift replacement. Weekend cleaning in progress across all lines.
per_plant_summary.L2: No activity in the last 24 hours.
per_plant_summary.L3: ML4 completed level 2 cleaning but has multiple open items flagged for Monday: drive shaft metal dust, gondola cleaning failure, bent belt door, and pre-heat cabinet chain out of sync. Truffle line cleaned successfully and passed all ATP tests. ML1 molds passed ATP.

notes.text: Spatula storage safety reminder issued — team coached to place blade inward per standard.
Macadamia inventory question raised for Monday — 20112 showing zero stock but 20112-Costco available.

resolved.title: Metal detector repeatedly opening on Sollich 2
resolved.summary: Metal detector on pack line kept triggering false rejects, halting flow.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 15:24 — "MD no longer opens, it is working correctly" (Elizabeth Hernandez).

resolved.title: Russel Finex filter clog caused low enrober pressure on Sollich 3
resolved.summary: First shift left return pump on manual while purging the clog, draining the enrober and causing abnormally low pressure at second shift start.
resolved.resolution: Cleared by shift start at 16:01 — "Everything seems to be working as it should now" (William Beattie).

needs_attention.title: Corn syrup pump motor defective on Sollich 2
needs_attention.summary: Pump motor failed inspection at 10:56; maintenance confirmed defective unit requiring replacement but shutting off water supply.
needs_attention.status: Running manually per Curt's direction at 11:55; replacement scheduled for third shift, no confirmation of completion.

needs_attention.title: Butter melting tank heater offline on Sollich 3
needs_attention.summary: Kitchen operator noticed tank no longer heating around 20:30; enough caramel inventory remained to run until 22:20 without impact.
needs_attention.status: William Lopez investigating as of 21:44; production unaffected for second shift.

needs_attention.title: Label machine printer error on Sollich 2
needs_attention.summary: Printer error during MMK caramel dark label setup that maintenance could not clear.
needs_attention.status: Error persists as of 07:29; Troy Baxter notified.

needs_attention.title: Metal detector installation incomplete on Sollich 3
needs_attention.summary: Metal detector installation requires two maintenance techs but only one available during weekend cleaning.
needs_attention.status: Installation deferred to Monday; check weigher, label machine, capper, and x-ray passed ATP and ready.

needs_attention.title: Drive shaft producing metal dust on ML4
needs_attention.summary: Maintenance traced metal dust contamination to the drive shaft; repair requires first shift expertise.
needs_attention.status: Source identified as of 19:18; Nelson Cook and Nathan Ruiz tagged to address Monday.

needs_attention.title: Fine dust observed on strips after demolding on ML4
needs_attention.summary: Significant amounts of fine dust still visible on chocolate strips following demolding step.
needs_attention.status: Observed during visual inspection at 05:08; no corrective action taken.

needs_attention.title: Pre-heating cabinet chain unsynchronized on ML4
needs_attention.summary: Chain synchronization issue prevented completion of pre-heating cabinet cleaning.
needs_attention.status: Unable to finish cleaning as of 08:00.

needs_attention.title: Belt to TG5 bent and won't close on ML4
needs_attention.summary: Exit belt door from gondola to TG4/TG5 is bent and does not close properly.
needs_attention.status: Bent door noted at 08:36 and confirmed by Kavin at 09:40; flagged for Monday.

needs_attention.title: Gondola failed cleaning inspection on ML4
needs_attention.summary: Gondola section did not pass visual due to excess chocolate and improperly cleaned belts; ATP test not performed but unit reassembled per supervisor direction for Monday testing.
needs_attention.status: Failed visual at 09:03; gondola belts not reassembled and require Monday completion per Kavin at 09:40.

needs_attention.title: Flow-wrap centerlines not matching on Truffle Line
needs_attention.summary: Total centerlines 4 showing misalignment on flow-wrap machine.
needs_attention.status: Centerline mismatch noted at 14:48 and again at 22:27; no corrective action logged.

needs_attention.title: Tube holder does not fit plastic liner opening
needs_attention.summary: Stainless steel tube holder for pump tube is too large to fit through the plastic liner opening.
needs_attention.status: Fitment issue documented at 15:59 with photos; no workaround or fix identified.

needs_attention.title: Vibration 4 and preheat 2 failed visual inspection on ML4
needs_attention.summary: PTL pump #2 components did not pass visual during level 2 cleaning; team had already left site.
needs_attention.status: Area pending as of 23:15; cleaning team offsite.
